universe: as name_history_prereg.json: each session D, top 400 by RAW SIP close x volume on D-1 over the bro_sr_wr asset set (US common stock, no ETF/ETP/levered), raw close on D-1 >= $10
data: SIP 1-minute bars (Alpaca historical), RAW prices, RTH 09:30-16:00 for structure and exits. 15-minute bars and 60-minute bars are built from 1-minute bars aligned to 09:30 (60-min: 09:30-10:30, ..., 15:30-16:00 half bar); a bar is COMPLETED when its end <= the decision time. Sessions from the Alpaca calendar: 2026-06-09 .. 2026-10-07; the first 10 SESSIONS (by count) are structure look-back only; test sessions start with the 11th (~74). If the outcome-blind count step (power) projects MDE > 15 bp, the primary sample is extended back to 2025-11-03 BEFORE any scoring. SIP NBBO quotes at entry and at time exits. After hours only; requests/failures recorded; abort if > 2% of name-days fail; a split inside the look-back drops the name-day. 1-minute bars from 2026-05-26 are fetched for BETA only (adjusted bars, prior 20 sessions, >= 100 non-overlapping 30-min pairs). Daily SIP bars (adjusted) for the 60 sessions before each test session feed the information cells (ATR14 from the prior 14, SMA50 from the prior 50); the 'next older swing high' uses the 60-min swing-high series.

definitions.swing: on a bar series, bar i is a swing high if high(i) > high of each of bars i-2, i-1, i+1, i+2 (strict), a swing low if low(i) < each of their lows; it is KNOWN only at the end of bar i+2 (no look-ahead); 60-min swings run over the RTH 60-min bar sequence concatenated across sessions (the overnight gap is ignored; the 15:30-16:00 half bar is a normal bar and can be a swing point); 15-min structure uses the CURRENT session's RTH bars only
definitions.UP60: at decision time t: among 60-min swing points known by t (look-back: prior 10 sessions + today), the last two swing highs are ascending AND the last two swing lows are ascending
definitions.rejection_bar: a completed 15-min bar with range > 0, lower wick (min(open, close) - low) >= 50% of the range, and close in the upper half of the range
definitions.momentum_bar: a completed 15-min bar with close > open, body >= 60% of the range, and close > the previous 15-min bar's high
definitions.costs: entry at the SIP NBBO mid at t + 5 s, cost half the entry spread; exit cost half the SIP spread at the exit minute; quotes come from a new helper that returns the quote timestamp and must be <= 5 s old (bro_sr_wr.quote has no timestamp); an entry quote older than 5 s drops the pair (outcome-blind, counted); a time-exit quote older than 5 s falls back to that 1-min bar's close (counted, never a drop); if the two arms' drop rates differ by > 2 percentage points the run is FAILED-DATA

setups.S2_continuation_pullback: TOUCH = the first completed 15-min bar with bar START >= 10:00 such that its low <= L x 1.001, the previous completed bar's low > L x 1.001 (approach from above), and UP60 is true at the touch bar's END, where L = the most recent 60-min swing LOW known at the touch bar's end (the last higher low). The touch bar never enters and never cancels. Within the next 8 completed 15-min bars: a bar closing < L x 0.99 cancels; otherwise ENTRY at the close t of the first momentum_bar that comes after >= 2 rejection_bars (the touch bar may count as one), if t is 10:30-14:30 ET. STOP = the lowest low from the touch bar to t, minus $0.01. The scan for the next touch resumes only after this candidate resolves (entry, cancel, 8-bar expiry, or an R-bound skip); an R-bound skip ends the candidate (a later momentum bar in the same window does not enter).
setups.S3_break_and_retest: At each 15-min bar end (current session RTH only), CONSOLIDATION = the 4 most recent completed bars if (max high - min low) <= 1.0% of the last close; M = their max high. BREAK = the next completed bar closing > M x 1.001 with body >= 50% of its range; the first break fixes M (later consolidations are scanned only after this candidate resolves). Between the break and the retest, a bar closing < M cancels. RETEST = the first bar within the next 6 completed bars meeting ALL of: low <= M x 1.001, close >= M, rejection_bar. ENTRY at its close t if t is 10:30-14:30 ET. STOP = the retest bar's low minus $0.01. No trend condition. After a candidate resolves (entry, cancel, or 6 bars without a retest), the scan for a new consolidation restarts at the bar after the resolution. The next consolidation's 4 bars must all end after the resolving bar.
setups.common: one trade per name per setup per session (the first ENTRY), for every setup S2-S7; after a cancel or an R-bound skip the scan continues for a later setup that day (all setups S2-S7). R = entry - stop; skip (counted) if R < 0.15% or > 2.0% of the entry. TARGET = entry + 3R (primary), + 2R (information). MAX HOLD = 80 minutes for BOTH arms (every entry by 14:30 has >= 80 min left, so time-left cannot differ between arms). EXIT scanning starts with the 1-min bar beginning at t + 60 s: a bar whose low <= stop exits at min(stop, that bar's open); a bar whose high >= target exits at the target; a bar doing both = stop; otherwise the mid at entry + 80 min (or the 15:50 mid if earlier). Outcome: net bp and R-multiple. Exit quotes: target and stop exits use the last SIP quote at or before the END of the exit bar; if older than 5 s, the entry spread is used (counted, never a drop). SPY for the hedge is priced at the same instant (the end of the exit bar for intrabar exits). The 15:50 / max-hold time-exit fallback uses the close of the 1-min bar ending at entry + 80 min (or at 15:50).
setups.S4_first_new_high: (Ross Cameron bull flag / micro pullback, 1-min bars) POLE = >= 3 consecutive green 1-min bars (close > open) whose last close >= 1.005 x the first bar's open and whose high is the session high so far; PULLBACK = the next 2-5 consecutive red bars (close < open), with every low > the pole's first open and the deepest low not below the pole's midpoint; ENTRY at the close t of the first bar after the pullback whose close > the previous bar's high, if the session high so far is >= +3% above the prior close and t is 10:30-14:30. STOP = the pullback's lowest low minus $0.01. A pullback longer than 5 bars, or a close below the pole's first open, cancels. Precisions: the pole is the maximal run of green bars ending at the first non-green bar; a doji (close = open) ends a run; midpoint = (pole first open + pole high)/2; the entry bar is the FIRST non-red bar after 2-5 red bars - if it does not close above the previous bar's high the candidate ends; '+3%' = the RTH session high through t vs the raw D-1 close.
setups.S5_level_double_bottom_or_pin: (key-level video) LEVELS known at t: 60-min swing lows from the last 5 sessions (swing rule above) and the prior session's RTH low. TOUCH = a completed 15-min bar (start >= 10:00) whose low is within +/-0.15% of a level and whose previous bar's low is > level x 1.0015 (approach from above). ENTRY at the close t of either (a) PIN: the touch bar itself if its lower wick >= 60% of its range and its close is in the upper third, or (b) DOUBLE BOTTOM: a later 15-min bar, 3-12 bars after the touch, whose low is within +/-0.15% of the touch low, that closes green, with no close below level x 0.9985 in between; whichever comes first; t 10:30-14:30. STOP = the lower of the touch low and the second low, minus $0.01. One trade per name per session for S5 (the first level touched). Precisions: levels are 60-min swing lows KNOWN at t from the prior 5 sessions AND today; if two levels fall in the band, the nearest to the touch low is used; 'in between' excludes the second bar; a touch bar closing below level x 0.9985 cancels that touch; after a cancel or skip the scan continues (the common rule) - 'one trade per session' means at most one S5 ENTRY.
setups.S6_sweep_displacement_fvg: (ICT video, 5-min RTH bars, current session) SWEEP = a completed 5-min bar whose low < the most recent 5-min swing low known at its start (swing rule above) and that closes back above that swing low; DISPLACEMENT = within the next 6 bars, the first bar k that closes above the highest high between the swept swing low and the sweep, with low(k+1) > high(k-1) (a bullish fair value gap, FVG = [high(k-1), low(k+1)]), known at the end of bar k+1; ENTRY = the first 1-min bar after that whose low <= the FVG top (low(k+1)), entry at the mid 5 s after that 1-min bar's end, within the next 12 5-min bars, if 10:30-14:30; a 5-min close below the FVG bottom first cancels. STOP = the sweep bar's low minus $0.01. Precisions: k is the FIRST bar within the 6 that satisfies BOTH the close condition and the FVG condition (a close without an FVG does not end the candidate); 'highest high between' includes the swept swing-low bar and the sweep bar; the 12 bars count from the end of k+1; if the entry mid is <= the stop or < the FVG bottom the trade is skipped (counted); R = entry mid - stop.
setups.S7_ICC_second_break: (ICC video) INDICATION = a completed 60-min RTH bar today (ends 10:30-14:30) that closes above H, the most recent 60-min swing high known at its start; the indication must be the FIRST 60-min close above H today with the previous completed 60-min close <= H; CORRECTION = afterwards, at least one completed 15-min bar closes below H; CONTINUATION = the first later completed 15-min bar that closes above H x 1.001 after the correction formed a 15-min low (the correction's lowest low) - ENTRY at its close t if t is 10:30-14:30 (same session only). STOP = the correction's lowest low minus $0.01. Information: target = the indication bar's high instead of 3R. Precisions: correction low = the minimum low from the end of the indication bar to the bar before the continuation; a 15-min close below that correction low before the continuation does not cancel, it lowers the correction low; the candidate is cancelled at 14:30 or if a 15-min close falls below the pre-indication 60-min swing low; information cell skips trades whose indication high is <= the entry.

control: SAME-NAME, SAME-GEOMETRY: for each event, a random completed 15-min bar close in the same name and session between 10:30 and 14:30 ET, not within 60 min of the event's entry, seeded by int(sha256(f'67|{setup}|{symbol}|{session}').hexdigest()[:16], 16) (reproducible across processes); entry at that bar close's mid + 5 s, the SAME stop distance in %, the SAME 3R target, the SAME 80-min max hold and exit/cost rules. No legal bar -> pair dropped (counted). Reported for both arms: realized vol over the prior 30 min, median hold, and entry clock time. Also reported: the paired difference with controls re-weighted to the events' entry-hour distribution (a sign flip is flagged; it does not change the pass). For S4 and S6 (minute entries) the control is a random completed 1-min bar close (10:30-14:30, not within 60 min of the event), same seed rule.
statistic: CO-PRIMARY: (a) raw and (b) beta-hedged paired difference, event net bp minus control net bp, where the hedge subtracts beta x SPY's return over EACH arm's own [entry, exit] window, priced at SPY's NBBO mid (beta from the name's non-overlapping 30-min RTH returns on SPY's, prior 20 sessions, >= 100 pairs else dropped and counted). Mean with two-way clustered SE (session, name); halves = alternate test sessions (calendar order).
power: OUTCOME-BLIND COUNT STEP before any event outcome: event counts and distinct names per setup (S2-S7) per half; projected SE = sqrt(2) x the two-way clustered SE of the CONTROL arm's net per half (no event outcome read); projected MDE = the larger of the two half MDEs, (t_crit + 0.84) x SE. The control outcomes read in this step are used for nothing else before scoring. If projected MDE > 15 bp, extend the primary sample to 2025-11-03 first (the out-of-period rerun then uses 2025-05-01..2025-10-31). After scoring: UNDERPOWERED only if MDE > 15 bp; if <= 15 bp in both halves and the pass is not met, FAIL. Extension decision: extend if ANY setup's projected MDE exceeds 15 bp.
pass: per setup (Bonferroni 6, one-sided t_crit = the t value with one-sided p = 0.025/6 (z 2.64 equivalent) at the smaller cluster df), on BOTH the raw and the hedged series: paired difference >= +5 bp with two-way t >= t_crit, positive in both halves, event net bp > 0 after costs, and after dropping the 5 names and (separately) the 3 sessions with the largest share of the difference the difference stays >= 0 and the event net stays > 0; AND the required STOP-SLIPPAGE cell (stop exits filled at min(that bar's open, (stop + that bar's low)/2), with the exit-quote rule above, both arms) keeps the difference >= 0 on BOTH the raw and the hedged series. FAIL if two-way t <= -2 on either series, or as in 'power'. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED. A PASS must be RERUN with the same code on >= 60 earlier sessions AND on IEX bars (IEX bars for structure and exits, SIP quotes for cost), each showing a raw and hedged paired difference > 0 with two-way t >= 1.64 and event net > 0, else FAIL; only then a forward paper test on the desk is pre-registered. No information cell, and neither the hedged nor the stop-slippage cell, can be promoted on its own; none of the ~15 thresholds can be re-tuned after a FAIL.
